```{r chart-errors-per-minute, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

unique_files <- sort(unique(raw_data$app_name))

plots <- map(unique_files, function(f) {
  file_data <- raw_data %>%
    filter(app_name == f)

  if (nrow(file_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 20px; color: #999; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("No data available for: ", f)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  subtitle_text <- build_run_testname_subtitle(
    file_data %>% distinct(run_id, test_name)
  )

  # ============================================================
  # 1. AGGREGATE PER MINUTE — error count by label, per run_id
  # ============================================================
  error_data <- file_data %>%
    mutate(
      minute_mark = as.POSIXct(format(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:00"), tz = "UTC"),
      is_error    = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("false", "no")
    ) %>%
    filter(is_error) %>%
    group_by(run_id, label, minute_mark) %>%
    summarise(error_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  if (nrow(error_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #2E8B57; padding: 20px; color: #2E8B57; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("✓ No errors recorded for: ", f)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 2. COMPUTE TOTAL ERRORS PER MINUTE (for tooltip)
  # ============================================================
  error_totals <- error_data %>%
    group_by(run_id, minute_mark) %>%
    summarise(total_per_minute = sum(error_count), .groups = "drop")

  error_data <- error_data %>%
    left_join(error_totals, by = c("run_id", "minute_mark"))

  # ============================================================
  # 3. COLOR PALETTE ASSIGNMENT
  # ============================================================
  all_unique_labels  <- sort(unique(error_data$label))
  set.seed(42)
  transaction_colors <- setNames(choose_palette(length(all_unique_labels)), all_unique_labels)

  error_data <- error_data %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels))

  # ============================================================
  # 4. DYNAMIC HEIGHT
  # ============================================================
  dynamic_height <- 500

  # ============================================================
  # 5. BUILD GGPLOT — stacked bars, faceted by run_id
  # ============================================================
  p <- ggplot(
    error_data,
    aes(
      x    = minute_mark,
      y    = error_count,
      fill = label,
      text = paste0(
        "Run ID: ",              run_id,
        "\nTransaction: ",       label,
        "\nTime: ",              format(minute_mark, "%H:%M"),
        "\nErrors This Label: ", error_count,
        "\nTotal Errors This Minute: ", total_per_minute
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(
      stat     = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      width    = 45
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = transaction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Timeline (Minute Intervals)",
      y = "Error Count"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~run_id, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing   = unit(2, "lines"),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Consolas", size = 10),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 10),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(r = 20)),
      strip.text      = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 11, color = "#333", face = "bold")
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 6. CONVERT TO PLOTLY
  # ============================================================
  pl <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", height = dynamic_height)

  # ============================================================
  # 7. LAYOUT CONFIG
  # ============================================================
  layout_config <- list(
    showlegend = TRUE,
    margin     = list(l = 100, r = 40, b = 80, t = 80),
    dragmode   = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
    height     = dynamic_height,
    width      = NULL,
    title      = list(
      text    = paste0(
        "<b>Errors Per Minute: ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f),
        "<br><sup>", subtitle_text, "</sup></b>"
      ),
      x       = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
    )
  )

  for (i in 1:10) {
    x_name <- if (i == 1) "xaxis" else paste0("xaxis", i)
    y_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)

    if (i == 1) {
      layout_config[[x_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$automargin <- TRUE
    } else {
      layout_config[[x_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
      layout_config[[y_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
    }
  }

  pl <- do.call(layout, c(list(pl), layout_config)) %>%
    config(
      responsive     = TRUE,
      displayModeBar = TRUE,
      toImageButtonOptions = list(
        format   = "png",
        filename = paste0("Errors_Per_Minute_", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f), "_", Sys.Date()),
        height   = dynamic_height,
        width    = 1400
      ),
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
        "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
        "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
      )
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
      pl
    ),
    render_observation_panel(
      chart_id = paste0(
        "chart_errorsPerMinute_",
        f
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
)
```
